description: "When is the glass picked up on my street?" has a real answer only where operators publish one. Când Reciclăm gives Bucharest residents the actual per-address collection calendar for Sector 1 (and household waste for Sector 2), extracted from the operators' official publications and linked to the source on every row. For sectors that don't publish per-address schedules (3–6), it does something rarer: it says so, transparently — what each operator does publish, what it doesn't, and how residents can actually find out (dispatch numbers, collection points, partner apps), all source-linked with verification dates. A practical sorting guide covers the hard cases: batteries, used cooking oil, medicines, e-waste, bulky items, textiles and SGR deposit-return — with concrete drop-off points. Free, no account, no ads.
